first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a guarded onboarding simplification test the most direct path to sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the prior onboarding effect and the competing promotional-pricing evidence, since pricing may address competitor losses but could trade durable revenue quality for short-term acquisition. Guard the test with qualification, retention, and downstream revenue metrics rather than optimizing completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded experiment simplifying onboarding this week. The verified evidence shows completion improves 13%, time-to-value falls by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increases 3%, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not use promotional pricing as the primary intervention: its 18% qualified-revenue lift is offset by a 12% retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle. Measure activation, qualified revenue, renewal retention, and downstream account quality—not completion alone—and roll out broadly only if those outcomes remain positive.
